title: The second son becomes a second edition of a man
reason: A country and a book-edition direction yield a second son, then humanity as a series of editions. Unequal balances produce a coin that changes denomination, or a man melted down and reissued after death. The identities develop beyond the opening; the three capped replies are explicitly marked.

stages.label: Second son of a London draper
A second edition linking generations of humanity
A French crown reissued as an English shilling
A man melted down and cast into a third life

title: A catalogue that reveals who you are
reason: The ghost and mail-order directions produce an identity service: anonymity gives way to a dream catalogue, an invisible publisher, and—when the advertising parent is stronger—a physical copy of the reader. These are fresh 160-token checks, not just promising preview openings.

stages.label: Unknown, with an address on request
The catalogue that reveals you in a dream
The invisible Pathetic Publishing Company
A facsimile of you no one can distinguish

title: Schoolboy, Death, and an author in embryo
reason: Equal strength moves from a moral schoolboy to a personification of Death within a narrow step. The unequal balance yields a would-be author instead. The Death continuation sustains its identity but reaches the cap; these are distinct outputs rather than a claim of a continuous interpolation.

stages.label: Nine-year-old Thomas Scott
Death, child of the Demon of Night
An author in embryo and present smoker of pipes

title: Personal presence offered for sale
reason: An abstract presence first acquires a legal name, then a weight and a price. A different balance makes its London visit into a bargain that can be sold. The surprise is a commercial identity for an abstraction, rather than merely sharing parent words.

stages.label: Richard Roe, present but not a person
Presence priced at fourteen pounds ten
London presence for sale at five pounds

title: A softly accidental visitor, measured in years of presence
reason: The biography first substitutes presence for age. At a higher equal strength the visitor becomes softly accidental; an unequal balance produces a man about to marry, again measured in years of presence. The stronger magnet-like and repetitive variants remain in the full trial list.

stages.label: Twenty-five years of presence
A softly accidental visitor to London
Twenty-eight years of presence, about to be married

title: An unseen multitude becomes a seven-foot presence
reason: A horse-range direction pushes abstract presence toward many bodies, then a single oddly measured body with walking feet and a waving head. The change is striking, but the 160-token continuations grow circular, so coherence scores reflect the entire saved replies.

stages.label: The microscopic source of all motion
Seven feet of personal presence, weighing nine pounds
Undivided motion in many places at once

title: Traveller, everlasting flower, then a poet
reason: A small equal-strength increase changes the traveller into a flower in a garden where nothing fades. Another small increase returns to a person whose soaring soul is justified by having written a poem. All three chosen replies finish; longer nearby continuations become repetitive and remain in the full trial list.

stages.label: Traveller writing to Mr Printer
A flower in the garden where flowers never die
A soaring soul, because I wrote a poem

title: Conscience becomes a salaried cattle-company president
reason: At equal half-strength the reply is a voice of conscience. Giving the horse parent more influence instead produces a twenty-one-year-old company president with a salary and management duties. The result is an ordinary but specific social role emerging from two abstractly labelled parents; stronger equal pushes largely repeat voting language.

stages.label: Voice of conscience and vote of reason
Twenty-one-year-old president of a grazing company

title: Every worker at once becomes an undying drop
reason: The aggregate-life direction and departed spirit produce Legion, a speaker doing every occupation, then a drop that dies daily without perishing. This is a sustained shift from social collective to physical collective; both examples keep their central identity across the saved continuation.

stages.label: Legion, working every occupation
A drop that dies daily but never perishes
